caption: Same stretch of time after the split at height 100: the new-rule chain, with 85% of hash power, mines 2016 blocks and reaches height 2116, while the old-rule chain, with 15%, mines only 356 blocks and reaches height 456. A hard fork gives two chains like this; a soft fork leaves one chain because old nodes still accept the new blocks.

spec.aria: Timeline of a hard fork starting at height 100: the new-rule chain holding 85 percent of hash power mines 2016 blocks and reaches height 2116, while in the same time the old-rule chain holding 15 percent mines 356 blocks and reaches height 456.
